h1: Password reset flows that cut support requests
overview: Forgotten passwords are the most common reason people write to support. We build a reset flow that is easy for the customer and hard to abuse. The user asks for a link, gets a branded email, chooses a new password on a secure page and is signed in again. Links expire and work once, the page never reveals whether an email exists, and old sessions can be ended.

faq: Is a reset link safe to email?
Yes, when done properly. Each link is random, single-use and short-lived. We also avoid saying whether an email exists on your site, so strangers cannot probe for accounts.
Can people reset by text message instead?
This service covers email. Text resets need an SMS provider and extra care because numbers can be hijacked. If you need it, tell us and we quote it separately.
What if my emails land in spam?
We check the sender name, template and basic email settings such as SPF and DKIM with you. We cannot control every inbox, but a correct setup improves the chance of arrival.
Can you improve a reset flow that already exists?
Yes. Share the project, and we test the current flow for weak points such as links that never expire. We then fix them without changing your user records.
